mapper.sql: k.employee_no as "employeeNo", k.name, k.organization_code as "organizationCode", org.organization_name as "organizationName", k.rank_name as "rankName", k.appointment_id as "appointmentId", p.contact, p.researcher_registration_no as "researcherRegistrationNo", p.external_provision_yn as "externalProvisionYn", p.information_public_yn as "informationPublicYn", p.final_degree_type as "finalDegreeType", coalesce(p.degree_prerequisite_missing_yn, 'N') = 'Y' as "degreePrerequisiteMissing", p.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from korus_personnel_snapshots k left join organizations org on org.organization_code = k.organization_code left join researcher_profiles p on p.employee_no = k.employee_no
from korus_personnel_snapshots k left join organizations org on org.organization_code = k.organization_code left join researcher_profiles p on p.employee_no = k.employee_no

sql.where:
k.status = 'ACTIVE'
and ( k.employee_no ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or k.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or k.organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(org.organization_name, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(p.researcher_registration_no, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') )

where.if: and ( faculty_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or faculty_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(organization_code, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(organization_name, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(rank_name, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(appointment_id, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
select faculty_id as "facultyId", faculty_name as "facultyName", organization_code as "organizationCode", organization_name as "organizationName", rank_name as "rankName", employment_status as "employmentStatus", position_name as "positionName", appointment_id as "appointmentId" from faculty_search_results
order by faculty_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select coalesce(p.researcher_registration_no, k.employee_no) as "researcherProfileId", k.employee_no as "facultyId", k.name as "facultyName", k.organization_code as "organizationCode", org.organization_name as "organizationName", k.rank_name as "rankName", k.employment_status as "employmentStatus", p.final_degree_type as "finalDegreeType", case when p.employee_no is null then 'MISSING_PROFILE' else 'ACTIVE' end as "profileStatus", p.information_public_yn as "informationPublicYn", p.updated_at as "updatedAt"
order by k.employee_no limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

where.if: and ( target_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or researcher_profile_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or faculty_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or faculty_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(organization_code, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or coalesce(organization_name, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or deficiency_reason ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
select target_id as "targetId", researcher_profile_id as "researcherProfileId", faculty_id as "facultyId", faculty_name as "facultyName", organization_code as "organizationCode", organization_name as "organizationName", final_degree_type as "finalDegreeType", deficiency_reason as "deficiencyReason", updated_at as "updatedAt" from degree_deficiency_targets
order by faculty_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into researcher_profiles (employee_no, contact, external_provision_yn, information_public_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (#{employeeNo}, '', 'N', 'N', #{changedBy}, #{changedBy}) on conflict (employee_no) do nothing
mapper.select: select research_field_id as "researchFieldId", employee_no as "employeeNo", major_name as "majorName", detail_major_name as "detailMajorName", major_series as "majorSeries", changed_by as "changedBy", changed_at as "changedAt" from researcher_research_fields where employee_no = #{employeeNo} order by research_field_id

select career_id as "careerId", employee_no as "employeeNo", work_start_ym as "workStartYm", work_end_ym as "workEndYm", workplace, position_name as "positionName", duty, changed_by as "changedBy", changed_at as "changedAt" from researcher_careers where employee_no = #{employeeNo} order by career_id

select degree_id as "degreeId", employee_no as "employeeNo", degree_type as "degreeType", university_name as "universityName", start_ym as "startYm", acquired_ym as "acquiredYm", country_name as "countryName", college_name as "collegeName", advisor_name as "advisorName", changed_by as "changedBy", changed_at as "changedAt" from researcher_degrees where employee_no = #{employeeNo} order by degree_id

select certification_id as "certificationId", employee_no as "employeeNo", acquired_ym as "acquiredYm", certification_name as "certificationName", issuing_organization_name as "issuingOrganizationName", changed_by as "changedBy", changed_at as "changedAt" from researcher_certifications where employee_no = #{employeeNo} order by certification_id
mapper.insert: insert into researcher_research_fields (employee_no, major_name, detail_major_name, major_series, changed_by) values (#{employeeNo}, #{item.majorName}, #{item.detailMajorName}, #{item.majorSeries}, #{changedBy})

insert into researcher_careers (employee_no, work_start_ym, work_end_ym, workplace, position_name, duty, changed_by) values (#{employeeNo}, #{item.workStartYm}, #{item.workEndYm}, #{item.workplace}, #{item.positionName}, #{item.duty}, #{changedBy})

insert into researcher_degrees (employee_no, degree_type, university_name, start_ym, acquired_ym, country_name, college_name, advisor_name, changed_by) values (#{employeeNo}, #{item.degreeType}, #{item.universityName}, #{item.startYm}, #{item.acquiredYm}, #{item.countryName}, #{item.collegeName}, #{item.advisorName}, #{changedBy})

insert into researcher_certifications (employee_no, acquired_ym, certification_name, issuing_organization_name, changed_by) values (#{employeeNo}, #{item.acquiredYm}, #{item.certificationName}, #{item.issuingOrganizationName}, #{changedBy})

insert into faculty_search_results (faculty_id, faculty_name, organization_code, organization_name, rank_name, employment_status, position_name, appointment_id, source_snapshot_employee_no, updated_at) select k.employee_no, k.name, k.organization_code, org.organization_name, k.rank_name, k.employment_status, k.position_name, k.appointment_id, k.employee_no, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP from korus_personnel_snapshots k left join organizations org on org.organization_code = k.organization_code where k.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and k.status = 'ACTIVE' on conflict (faculty_id) do update set faculty_name = EXCLUDED.faculty_name, organization_code = EXCLUDED.organization_code, organization_name = EXCLUDED.organization_name, rank_name = EXCLUDED.rank_name, employment_status = EXCLUDED.employment_status, position_name = EXCLUDED.position_name, appointment_id = EXCLUDED.appointment_id, source_snapshot_employee_no = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot_employee_no, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

insert into degree_deficiency_targets (target_id, researcher_profile_id, faculty_id, faculty_name, organization_code, organization_name, final_degree_type, deficiency_reason, source_degree_id, updated_at) select coalesce(d.degree_id::text, k.employee_no || '-DEGREE-DEFICIENCY'), coalesce(p.researcher_registration_no, k.employee_no), k.employee_no, k.name, k.organization_code, org.organization_name, p.final_degree_type, '박사 최종학위의 학사·석사·박사 선행학위 입력 여부를 확인하세요.', d.degree_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP from korus_personnel_snapshots k join researcher_profiles p on p.employee_no = k.employee_no left join organizations org on org.organization_code = k.organization_code left join lateral ( select degree_id from researcher_degrees degree where degree.employee_no = k.employee_no and degree.degree_type = 'DOCTOR' order by degree.degree_id limit 1 ) d on true where k.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and k.status = 'ACTIVE' and p.degree_prerequisite_missing_yn = 'Y' on conflict (target_id) do update set researcher_profile_id = EXCLUDED.researcher_profile_id, faculty_id = EXCLUDED.faculty_id, faculty_name = EXCLUDED.faculty_name, organization_code = EXCLUDED.organization_code, organization_name = EXCLUDED.organization_name, final_degree_type = EXCLUDED.final_degree_type, deficiency_reason = EXCLUDED.deficiency_reason, source_degree_id = EXCLUDED.source_degree_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: update researcher_profiles set updated_by = #{changedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where employee_no = #{employeeNo}
